hap_score.methodology_note: Computed from the Variables table on this page, not from the NZA data below. Six weighted components (Multifamily Access 30pts, Approval Discretion 10pts, Minimum Lot Size 20pts, ADU Approval Pathway 15pts, Parking Mandate 10pts, Demolition Delay 15pts) are each scored against a fixed, published rubric from a specific cited fact above. Higher = more restrictive.

v2.formula: V2 = sum(district score x acres) / sum(acres) over included districts
v2.method: Each district is scored with the same six-component rubric using only its own rules. A district is included only if at least 5 of 6 components are confirmed. The town V2 score is the land-area-weighted mean of included district scores; acreage is from data/land_area/norwalk.json. Components with no confirmed input are excluded per district.
